Hi there,

Choose whether your trial tests more JPG renders or both JPG and PNG from each design. Bannerbear is an image generation API that renders template-based marketing images from your data.

Credits follow a simple formula: image credits = requested formats × scale. At scale 1, one JPG costs 1 credit. Request JPG plus PNG from the same design, and the render costs 2 credits.

With no other credit-consuming operations, 30 credits cover up to 30 JPG-only renders or 15 JPG-plus-PNG renders at scale 1. Choose broader render coverage or dual-format output before the test begins.

The free trial includes 30 API credits, with no credit card required.

Connect the data source through a native integration (e.g. Airtable) or Zapier, or call the documented REST API directly
Budget credits per render: each requested format counts separately and the scale parameter multiplies credits
Trial accounts are limited to one workspace, three image templates, three animation templates, three workflows and three instant URLs

Volume is metered in credits (1,000/mo on Automate at $49, 10,000 on Scale at $149, with extra credits per additional format, per scale multiple and per AI layer), and of the named feed sources only Airtable (plus Notion, WordPress, Ghost) is documented as native — Google Sheets and a generic CMS are not established by the selected evidence except via the Zapier branch.
